Wallet / Send
Send from the Wallet: details, review, sent.
A send comes from the profile the Wallet is showing, named in its header. There is no step to pick a profile: switching is done on the Wallet page before starting. The details screen shows that profile's balance, and Review names it in From.
Palm check, per the workspace_owner on 2026-10-12: nobody sends money out of the wallet before a palm scan. Pressing Send without a current check shows the same step as Claim and leaves for the same verification page (Flows/Wallet/Claim); the details screen opens on return. Proposed and dashed: the send route has no palm check today, in the app or the API, and the API has to refuse an unverified send for the rule to hold. Receive needs no check.
Receive is a sheet on the Wallet page (Screens/Wallet/Portfolio).
Desktop: the same three steps in a dialog over the Wallet page. Changing profile closes it.
Phone: send. Details, review, sent; then Send with no current palm check (dashed: not enforced in the app or API yet)

Review and Sent are the same dialog in the same place. Escape and the scrim close it before the send is signed; after signing it stays until Done. Changing profile closes it, as on the phone.
Scan needed uses the same verification page as Claim (Flows/Wallet/Claim). Its last state is different for Send, drawn here: "Palm scan done. You can send now." Continue returns to the Wallet on the profile that was sending and opens Send details, empty. The scan never sends money by itself; the person still fills in, reviews and confirms. The same state serves the phone, but only this desktop version is drawn. Not built: the server has no palm check on Send, and the verification page has no Send purpose or return.
